Women with different causes of AI
outcome: Glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid dosage adjustments during pregnancy
cohort: 128 pregnancies in 113 women with different causes of AI from 19 international centers
finding: This survey of women with AI managed in specialized endocrine centers confirms good maternal and fetal outcomes.
